title: JSP 453 Digital Services Assurance Gate Process
description: Structured, project-neutral model derived from JSP 453 Digital Services Assurance Playbook concepts, the JSP453 flowchart and DEAB Assurance Matrix evidence categories. It captures gates, authority categories, roles and evidence artefacts without tying them to a specific supplier, tenant or application.

roles.title: Senior Responsible Owner
roles.description: Accountable for cyber secure outcomes through the capability lifecycle and for relevant controls being met when engaging with DEAB.
responsibilities: Signs off Secure by Design process and accepted project risks

roles.title: Information Asset Owner
roles.description: Approves access to and agreed use of data assets where applicable.

roles.title: Delivery Team Lead
roles.description: Coordinates the project evidence pack and gate submissions.

roles.title: Delivery Team Security Lead
roles.description: Coordinates security evidence, risk records, and security assessor engagement.

roles.title: JSP 453 Case Officer
roles.description: Provides case management, assurance triage, the PEF route and evidence collation before DEAB.
responsibilities: Coordinates JSP 453 Evidence Matrix artefacts before DEAB

roles.title: Digital Enterprise Approvals Board
roles.description: Authority for deployment/change, including AtT, IAtO, AtO and CAtO categories.

roles.title: Technical Design Authority
roles.description: Assures project compliance with reference architecture at major decision points.

roles.title: Technical or Solution Architect
roles.description: Provides design-principles declaration where TDA approval is not yet obtained.
responsibilities: Confirms design principles have been followed

roles.title: CyDR Security Architecture
roles.description: Reviews security architecture and service-zone/cross-domain controls.
responsibilities: Reviews service-zone and cyber architecture controls

roles.title: Cyber Defensive Operations
roles.description: Confirms relevant cyber defensive operational controls have been applied.
responsibilities: Provides written approval for applied controls

roles.title: Core Test Services
roles.description: Assures test strategies, plans, RTE and completion evidence for Defence Digital governance gates.

roles.title: OSM Onboarding
roles.description: Supports safe integration into live operation and the SIAM ecosystem.

roles.title: SACM Team
roles.description: Confirms Configuration Items are recorded in CMS/CMDB.

roles.title: OSM Resilience Team
roles.description: Confirms ITSCM, availability and capacity controls.

roles.title: Change Management SME
roles.description: Confirms change-management process and Forward Schedule of Change evidence.

roles.title: Change Advisory Board
roles.description: Authoritative forum for assessing, prioritising, authorising and scheduling standard and normal live-service changes.
responsibilities: Assesses business and technical change impact

roles.title: Emergency Change Advisory Board
roles.description: Emergency change authority used when urgent live-service change decisions are required.
responsibilities: Confirms emergency change risk and rollback approach

roles.title: Service Owner
roles.description: Owns the live service outcome and confirms the operational need and business impact for change.
responsibilities: Confirms business acceptance of change risk

roles.title: Event Management Team
roles.description: Confirms event-management controls and MDS template evidence.

roles.title: Knowledge Article Team
roles.description: Confirms MOD first-line service desk knowledge article evidence.

roles.title: GOSCC Annex A Team
roles.description: Confirms GOSCC Annex A/live support wrapper completion.

roles.title: Risk Owner or Senior Risk Officer
roles.description: Reviews exceptions, residual risk and risk acceptance where controls cannot be met.
responsibilities: Supports risk acceptance or remediation decisions

roles.title: Second Line Assessor
roles.description: Provides second-line assurance where applicable.

roles.title: Supplier or Engineering Team
roles.description: Provides implementation, test, build, scan and remediation evidence.

processes.title: JSP 453 Assurance Path to Authority
processes.description: End-to-end assurance path based on the JSP453 flowchart and DEAB Assurance Matrix: Front Door, JSP453 triage, assurance planning, AtT, test execution, IAtO, AtO and continual assurance.
entry_conditions: A Defence Digital service, product or solution requires JSP 453 assurance or DEAB authority to test or operate.
Demand has been raised through the relevant Front Door or Demand Book route.

exit_outcomes.title: Triaged out of JSP 453
exit_outcomes.description: Triage confirms the demand does not continue through the JSP 453 assurance path.

exit_outcomes.title: Authority to Test approved
exit_outcomes.description: DEAB approval allows controlled testing to proceed.

exit_outcomes.title: Interim Authority to Operate approved
exit_outcomes.description: DEAB approval allows interim operation subject to stated conditions and evidence caveats.

exit_outcomes.title: Authority to Operate approved
exit_outcomes.description: DEAB approval allows the service to operate under the agreed body of evidence and support model.

exit_outcomes.title: Continuous Authority to Operate maintained
exit_outcomes.description: Continuous authority is maintained through evidence refresh, risk review and controlled change.

exit_outcomes.title: Continue IAtO
exit_outcomes.description: DEAB allows interim authority to continue while remaining AtO blockers are resolved.

exit_outcomes.title: DEAB rejected
exit_outcomes.description: DEAB does not grant the requested authority and remediation or replanning is required.

transitions.label: Submission accepted
transitions.condition: Front Door evidence is complete enough for assurance triage.

transitions.label: JSP 453 applicable
transitions.condition: Triage confirms JSP 453 applies and the assurance plan is agreed.

transitions.label: Triaged out
transitions.condition: Triage confirms this route is not applicable.

gates.title: Defence Digital Front Door Submission
gates.description: Initial Front Door demand/submission before detailed JSP453 assurance, including DAA approval where applicable, questionnaire, HLD and BIA/project scope evidence.

criteria.title: Demand is raised through Front Door / Demand Book route
criteria.description: Demand is entered through the relevant ND/Defence Digital Front Door or Demand Book route and categorised for Technical Assurance (JSP453) where applicable.

criteria.title: Questionnaire, HLD and initial scope are complete
criteria.description: Initial questionnaire, project scope, HLD and business impact information are available for triage.

criteria.title: Core project roles are established
criteria.description: SRO, IAO, delivery/security leads and JSP453 case officer are identified before triage and evidence collation.

gates.title: JSP453 Triage and Assurance Plan
gates.description: Confirm JSP453 applicability, specialist assurance requirements, and the evidence route before AtT submission.

criteria.title: JSP453 triage decision is recorded
criteria.description: Triage determines whether the service proceeds through JSP453 assurance, is triaged out, or requires ND assurance confirmation.

criteria.title: Applicability checks are completed
criteria.description: Applicability is confirmed for SoA/CoCo, spectrum, EM integration, crypto management plan, geospatial, modelling and simulation, and AI/ML.

criteria.title: JSP453 assurance plan is agreed
criteria.description: Assurance plan identifies evidence matrix rows, owners, specialist approvals, and route to DEAB authority categories.

gates.title: Authority to Test (AtT) Submission and DEAB
gates.description: Prepare and submit the AtT evidence set to DEAB: HLD, service-zone/cross-domain/security design controls, cyber compliance, test plan, and Secure by Design/TSI evidence.

criteria.title: HLD, project scope and architecture approval are available
criteria.description: DEAB matrix contextual and technology evidence: end-to-end HLD, project scope, and TDA approval or architect design-principles declaration.

criteria.title: Security architecture and cyber compliance controls are evidenced
criteria.description: Security architecture, service-zone/cross-domain controls, cyber defensive controls, and applicable SoA/crypto controls have been reviewed.

criteria.title: Test strategy, test plan and RTE are accepted
criteria.description: Core Test Services confirms test plans, representative test environment and intended completion activities are adequate for AtT.

criteria.title: Secure by Design evidence is available for AtT
criteria.description: SbD evidence includes SRO sign-off, SRO details, DART TOA/CAAT references, vulnerability-management registration and risk evidence.

gates.title: Testing Completion and Interim Authority to Operate (IAtO)
gates.description: After AtT approval, testing is completed and IAtO evidence is submitted to DEAB: TCR, IT Health Check, cyber compliance, GOSCC Annex A, and SbD SRO sign-off.

criteria.title: Testing has completed and TCR is accepted
criteria.description: Test Completion Report and test evidence show that the service/product is fit for utility and warranty for interim operation.

criteria.title: IT Health Check and cyber compliance evidence are complete
criteria.description: IAtO submission includes IT Health Check outcome and current cyber compliance evidence.

criteria.title: Operational live support wrapper is accepted
criteria.description: GOSCC Annex A/live support wrapper is completed before live-service transition under IAtO.

criteria.title: SRO accepts residual risk for IAtO
criteria.description: SRO sign-off confirms SbD process, project risks, unresolved caveats or exceptions for interim operation.

gates.title: Authority to Operate (AtO) / Continue IAtO
gates.description: AtO submission confirms through-life operational management evidence: information plan, SACM, change, ITSCM, availability, capacity, event, knowledge, software/licensing and support wrapper controls.

criteria.title: Data and information management evidence is complete
criteria.description: Data through-life management plan, IAO approval where data assets are used, and DPIA where PII is processed are available.

criteria.title: Service configuration and asset records are complete
criteria.description: SACM confirms Configuration Items are in CMS/CMDB.

criteria.title: Resilience, availability and capacity controls are complete
criteria.description: ITSCM recovery plan, availability management plan and capacity management plan are approved or confirmed by OSM Resilience.

criteria.title: Change, event and knowledge management controls are complete
criteria.description: Change management plan/FSoC, event-management MDS template, and service desk knowledge article are approved.

criteria.title: Licensing and live support wrapper are complete
criteria.description: Software/licensing evidence and GOSCC Annex A/live support wrapper are available for AtO.

gates.title: Continuous Authority to Operate (CAtO)
gates.description: After successful authority approval, the service maintains a living body of evidence, reviews residual risk, and keeps the DEAB authority basis current through life.

criteria.title: Continuous authority basis is maintained
criteria.description: The authority basis, open caveats, risks and evidence refresh plan are reviewed so CAtO can be maintained or renewed.

criteria.title: Evidence pack remains a living record
criteria.description: The body of evidence and HLD are updated after operational learning, assurance decisions and approved service changes.

processes.title: CAB Live Change Authority
processes.description: Related JSP 453 live-service change authority path for standard, normal and emergency changes after a service is live, assured or registered. This flow is governed by CAB/eCAB rather than DEAB.
entry_conditions: A live, assured or registered service requires a standard, normal or emergency change.
The service has an existing authority or support model that must remain valid after the proposed change.

exit_outcomes.title: Change authorised
exit_outcomes.description: CAB authorises and schedules the change.

exit_outcomes.title: Emergency change authorised
exit_outcomes.description: eCAB authorises an emergency change with appropriate risk and rollback controls.

exit_outcomes.title: Change rejected or deferred
exit_outcomes.description: The change is rejected, deferred or returned for further evidence.

exit_outcomes.title: Change closed
exit_outcomes.description: Implementation is complete and post-change evidence has been recorded.

transitions.label: Change accepted for assessment
transitions.condition: Change record has enough service, scope and timing information for assessment.

transitions.label: Impact assessed
transitions.condition: Business, technical, security, operational and rollback impacts are understood.

gates.title: Live Change Raised
gates.description: A standard, normal or emergency live-service change is recorded with scope, affected service, implementation window and change owner.

criteria.title: Change record is complete
criteria.description: The change record identifies the service, affected components, proposed window, implementation owner and requested change category.

criteria.title: Current authority basis is known
criteria.description: The current AtO, IAtO or registered-service basis is identified so the effect of the change can be assessed.

gates.title: Impact and Risk Assessment
gates.description: Business, technical, cyber, service-management, rollback and schedule impacts are assessed before CAB/eCAB.

criteria.title: Business and service impact is assessed
criteria.description: The service owner confirms user, operational, availability and support impacts of the proposed change.

criteria.title: Technical and cyber risk is assessed
criteria.description: Technical, security, data, dependency and vulnerability impacts are assessed against the approved design and evidence baseline.

criteria.title: Implementation, backout and communications plan is ready
criteria.description: Implementation steps, rollback plan, testing/verification steps, maintenance window and stakeholder communications are documented.

gates.title: CAB / eCAB Decision
gates.description: CAB or eCAB assesses the change from business and technical viewpoints and authorises, rejects or defers the change.

criteria.title: CAB/eCAB pack is ready
criteria.description: The board pack includes change record, impact assessment, implementation plan, risk decision and requested outcome.

criteria.title: Authority decision is recorded
criteria.description: CAB/eCAB decision, conditions, schedule and required follow-up actions are recorded.

gates.title: Implementation and PCIR Closeout
gates.description: The authorised change is implemented, verified, reviewed and closed with post-change evidence and any follow-up actions.

criteria.title: Implementation evidence is recorded
criteria.description: Implementation result, validation checks, test evidence and rollback outcome are recorded.

criteria.title: Post Change Implementation Review is complete
criteria.description: PCIR captures whether the change succeeded, whether there were incidents or failed activities, and what follow-up actions remain.

criteria.title: Evidence baseline is updated
criteria.description: The HLD, body of evidence, operational support wrapper and risk record are updated where the change affects them.

process_links.label: Live change governed by CAB after AtO/IAtO
process_links.description: Once a service is operating or registered, subsequent live changes are governed through CAB/eCAB while DEAB authority evidence remains the baseline.

process_links.label: Closed changes update CAtO evidence
process_links.description: Post-change evidence and PCIR outputs feed the living evidence pack used for continuous authority.
